claims: "What" is a versatile English interrogative word.
"What" is used to inquire about the identity, nature, or value of an object, action, or idea.
"What" acts as a pronoun, determiner, or adverb.
"What" highlights that options are unlimited, unlike "which".
"What" acts as a filler ("You know what?").
"The what" refers to entity, thing, substance.
Use "what" for open-ended questions with many possibilities.
Use "which" when there is a restricted or limited set of options.
